gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-trocchi: Trocchi reads like a wide-open ring of a c, with bowls that thin out gently rather than sharply. Trocchi's soft modulation sits under Bellota Text, whose monoline skeleton gives headings a commanding, wire-straight presence.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-trykker: Refined, that serif body: moderate contrast, never stark, never flat. Trykker lets its counters breathe, while Bellota Text glides like wire above it, though a small heading would lose some of that commanding presence.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-uchen: Dignified, with a quiet pulse. Uchen's curves welcome the eye in, a gentle thick-thin rhythm that keeps going comfortably, while Bellota Text holds the headings with strokes that never taper.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-vollkorn-sc: Bellota Text bends its strokes like copper pipe. Vollkorn SC, a classic serif with loosely strung tracking and soft ink-drawn modulation, brings the literary warmth that the tubular heading lacks.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-yuji-syuku: Authoritative in a quiet way, Yuji Syuku spaces every glyph pair openly, and its classic serif curves stop short of turning inward. Bellota Text earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-bellota-text-ibm-plex-serif: Corporate poise meets a single-weight outline, with open shapes up top. And IBM Plex Serif, a classic serif with horizontals slimmer than its verticals, gives Bellota Text a respectable, authoritative partner.
gen-gf-boldonse-author: Author is a text serif with a slight swell on its bowls, like stone-carved lettering. Boldonse spreads out above it, every stem rope-like and commanding, so the two feel carved against braided.
gen-gf-boldonse-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Boldonse spreads its letters wide, each stroke one rope-like width, bold and commanding from end to end. But BhuTuka Expanded One is the real surprise: a curvy serif that slows reading to a leisurely walk.
gen-gf-boldonse-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab stretches every word out, its counters open and its strokes bent like a paperclip with no thick-thin shifts. Boldonse echoes that width above it.
gen-gf-boldonse-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru is a classic serif with generous letterspace, terminals that stop far from the stem, and rings for o's. Boldonse sits above it, bold and spread out.
